#!/bin/bash
# health_probe v1 (2026-11-15): 冻结自证记录仪——独立进程,不碰遥控器
LOG=/root/health.log
echo "$(date '+%m-%d %H:%M:%S') probe_started" >> $LOG
LAST=$(date +%s)
while true; do
  sleep 60
  NOW=$(date +%s)
  UP=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null | cut -d. -f1)
  ST=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/status 2>/dev/null || echo "?")
  CP=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/capacity 2>/dev/null || echo "?")
  ELAPSED=$((NOW-LAST))
  LAST=$NOW
  echo "$(date '+%m-%d %H:%M:%S') elapsed=${ELAPSED}s uptime=${UP}s batt=${ST} ${CP}%" >> $LOG
done
